en: This postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of an ornate, multi-storey school building with decorative gables and a small turret or spire. The building is situated on a public square with landscaped gardens and is surrounded by other period architecture. In the foreground, several children and adults are visible standing near a lamppost. The upper left of the card contains red printed German text.
